id: AT-AP-27 (moved approvals: a fence closes only on its own character, at least as long, 0.1.5 E-3 review round 5)
note: 0.1.5 E-3 review round 5. move_lines read any ``` or ~~~ line as a fence that opens or closes a block (0.1.4 A-3), so a ``` line inside a ~~~ block ended it and the block's own closing line opened one: a reference to a moved id inside the block was rewritten, and the references after it were not. Fences are now read as CommonMark reads them (skills::approvals::fence_lines, shared with publish's fixes): a block closes only on a line of its own character, at least as long, with nothing after it.
